players.product: Falcon platform AI: Charlotte AI detection triage and SafeMind agentic security, run on rented AI compute (Cerebras inference, CoreWeave GPUs, NVIDIA NIM)

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Burt Podbere: CrowdStrike now has over 2,900 customers on Falcon Flex, and customers come back to re-Flex on average eight months into the contract; Exposure Management was a $300 million ARR business a few quarters ago, its growth increased quarter over quarter, and CrowdStrike is 'rapidly approaching the same cadence of disclosures' for it, with disclosures on Guardian and its AI products to follow; services are about 5% of the P&L, treated as the biggest lead generator for product cross-sell; Microsoft is CrowdStrike's biggest competitor, though the two also work together on resiliency.
quarterly_data.figure: over 2,900 Flex customers; re-Flex on average eight months into the contract; Exposure Management $300 million ARR a few quarters ago

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Burt Podbere: SafeMind has not been released yet, so 'nothing really contemplated in the financials for this fiscal year. We contemplated it next year'; it will be monetized with packs of tokens plus additional packs; he expects AIDR, with Guardian, to be a bigger category than EDR.
